requirements_summary: Valesco needs a Private (air-gapped) deployment supporting classified-equivalent workloads and CUI. POC scope: deploy Redwood Private control plane as an appliance in isolated VLAN, integrate on-prem HSM (FIPS 140-2/3), SSO via SAML with on-prem IdP, audit logging retained for 7 years to internal archive, no outbound network connections allowed. Performance target: sustain 10 concurrent operator chat sessions and bulk document-search across 20M document corpus with <=120ms median token latency at 512 context; throughput requirement for batch embeddings job ~3M tokens/hour. Model preference: run an open LLM (quantized) validated by Redwood; fallback to smaller local distilled variant if resource constraints. Must provide signed images and reproducible image build pipeline for Gov inspection.
decision_criteria: Security & compliance first (HSM + no-egress + image signing), then deterministic latency. Ease of onboarding for SOC/infra team (clear port matrix, offline install steps) and vendor willingness to support on-site during POC. Price secondary but must fit within 12-month procurement band. References from other regulated customers and demonstrated air-gapped installs are high priority.
